note: Adapted from Emerson's (1928) species-level description; the original is in English and covers the soldier only. The original also questions the reliability of the alates attributed to this species, whose description is not included; the worker is not recorded; figure numbers and localities are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-yellow, slightly darker anteriorly than posteriorly; sides slightly rounded, slightly convergent forwards. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 4, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Labrum tongue-shaped, rounded at the apex, with numerous long setae. Mandibles black; apex curved; inner margin toothless except near the base. Fontanelle distinct. A small tuft of setae near the fontanelle. Pronotum distinctly broad, with flat lateral extensions; sides rounded, convergent posteriorly; posterior margin concave. Mesonotum much narrower than the pronotum. Metanotum wider than the mesonotum but much narrower than the pronotum. Abdominal tergites smooth, without distinct hairs or setae. Sternites with very short hairs, almost invisible. Total body length 9.00–10.00 mm; head length (with mandibles) 4.70–4.80 mm; head length (without mandibles) 3.80 mm; head width 2.78 mm; antennal length 2.57 mm; pronotum length 0.85 mm, width 2.35 mm; length of the hind tibia 1.90 mm; length of the left mandible 1.08 mm. Distinguished from T. brevinotus by the shape of the pronotum; the latter is also slightly smaller.
